description: Dry-run the submit gate on a build ZIP WITHOUT creating a listing or a review. Runs the same deterministic checks as a real submission: framework detection, bundle completeness (required lockfiles/sidecars/manifests per framework x OS), the SDK marker KO-10 for paid tools, and the file-count limit. This is NOT the full review — it does not run virus/CVE scan, sandbox or the LLM agent. Does NOT count toward the 5/24 h rate limit. Call it as often as needed until gate passes. Response: { gate: "pass"|"fail", framework, platforms, entrypoint, sdk_marker: { required, satisfied }, code?, message? }. On fail: code and message explain exactly what to fix. On sdk_marker.satisfied=false: embed CRELA_SDK_MARKER in the build env and rebuild. Always call this before submit_new_software or update_software. The response also carries storage_path: pass that to submit_new_software or update_software instead of file_path and the same ZIP is not uploaded a second time. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the build ZIP on disk. Omit when passing storage_path.

framework.description: Override; auto-detected from the ZIP if omitted

price_eur.description: 0 for free, > 0 for paid. Paid tools require the embedded SDK marker.

slug.description: The planned or existing tool slug (needed for the per-slug SDK marker check)

storage_path.description: storage_path from a previous precheck_build response - reuses that upload instead of sending the same ZIP again.

name: precheck_build
title: Pre-check a Crela build before submitting
